title: Try integer-lossless source codecs before changing lossy decoders

definition.title: Try integer-lossless source codecs before changing lossy decoders
definition.source_excerpt: New input-profile feasibility study · P1 · PROPOSED / NOT TESTED Extends: R10, R11. Reference primitives: S7, S3, E1. Question. Do ALAC or ordinary TrueHD stereo provide a genuinely necessary, sample-preserving FLAC adaptation case without selecting a different fixed decoder? Mechanism. Use the normal decoder of an integer-lossless source, encode its established integer output as FLAC, and packet-copy compatible video. Start with ALAC; generated TrueHD is a separate second profile, not an Atmos/DTS-HD claim. Smallest useful experiment. Inventory confirms host encoders exist. Generate 16/24-bit stereo 48 kHz references with distinct channels and low-level bit patterns. First test original Native and packet-copy alternatives. Only if those cannot meet the request, validate reference PCM → source codec → decoded PCM → FLAC → decoded PCM, then test host-progressive MSE playback.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially changes an eligible file from an expensive/unsupported route to correct native or minimal-transform playback. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used.
definition.minimum_probe: Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.
definition.initial_screen: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used. Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.
definition.primary_metric: Correct additional admitted source/destination capability; otherwise full startup and CPU/resource cost.
definition.scope_contract: Configuration and ordered codec payloads where copy is intended; requested frames/audio/timeline/features at the declared output boundary.
definition.negative_control: Alter one admission-critical configuration, remove a required dependency, or preserve video while making selected audio unsupported. Candidate must reject or use a declared fallback.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop before a new demuxer, player, codec build family or delivery service is needed. Record precisely which next implementation would unlock the screen.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

define.basis: Exact full-key mechanism, bounded workload, matched baseline and predeclared threshold.

prepare.basis: Fixtures, source/runtime hashes, independent PCM oracle, adverse and lifecycle controls pinned.

correctness.basis: Actual original native ALAC decode rejects; ordinary ALAC Wasm decoding plus ordinary FLAC adaptation and copied H264 produces384000 exact host PCM bytes/96000 stereo frames. Chrome recovers every signed16 sample exactly; all48 coded video packets are unchanged with normalized video timeline maximum error0.666ms (within the declared1.1ms source-timebase tolerance). Partial decoder job close/reopen, actual native MSE seek/audio/EOF and graph/worker cleanup pass. Finite bridge uses existing pinned modules, no different lossy decoder.

performance.basis: Original proposal is an input/destination feasibility question with no speed/resource hypothesis; performance is not applicable to this declared ALAC16 capability endpoint. Pursue normal integer-lossless adaptation for this profile. TrueHD,24bit, streaming memory ownership and production admission remain separately unqualified.

results.basis: New raw measurements and setup costs captured alongside pinned correctness reuse.

decision.basis: pursue: Original proposal is an input/destination feasibility question with no speed/resource hypothesis; performance is not applicable to this declared ALAC16 capability endpoint.
